name: agenda-gama
description: Agenda Gama - aplicativo escolar para web e Android

scripts.android:sync: npm run native:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.ios:sync: npm run native:prepare && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && cap open ios
